name: Pull-up
notes: Bodyweight vertical pull. Add external load only when appropriate.

guide.setup: Hang from a bar with hands just outside shoulder width and shoulders pulled gently away from the ears.
guide.execution: Drive the elbows down to pull the chest toward the bar, then lower under control to a still full hang.
guide.cues: Keep ribs down. Lead with the chest. Finish each rep without swinging.
guide.mistakes: Kipping for momentum; shrugging at the bottom; craning the neck; using only partial range.

images.caption: Chest lifted toward the bar with shoulders pulled down away from the ears.
